alate: Head brown; postclypeus pale yellowish brown, anteclypeus milky white, labrum greyish yellow, pronotum dark brown with a pale brown T-shaped mark and round spots; head and pronotum with sparse long and short hairs. Head nearly circular, the fontanelle small but visible, with a small spot in front of it; head width (including the eyes) greater than head length (to the base of the mandibles). In profile the dorsal margin of the head slightly arched; compound eyes nearly circular and projecting, ocelli oval and slightly projecting, the ocellus-compound eye distance shorter than half the short diameter of the ocellus and also shorter than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head; the postclypeus about half as long as wide. Antennae with 15 segments, the second about twice as long as the third, the third short and small, the fourth and fifth nearly equal. Pronotum narrower than the head, with a small notch in the middle of the anterior margin and a deep median concavity on the posterior margin; the posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum are likewise deeply concave.
